title: Strict henselization is ind-etale over an affine chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, s:Spec Ω→S an algebraically closed geometric point, i:Spec R→S an affine open immersion containing the image of the closed point of s, A a commutative ring, e:Spec A≅S_(s), and a:R→A a ring map whose spectrum composed with i equals e followed by the strict henselization structural map. Equip A with the algebra structure induced by a. Then A is ind-etale over R.

proof.text: Factor the geometric point through i using its singleton spectrum. Apply etale_local_ring_triples to obtain the initial chart subcategory, its equivalence E with residue triples, and compatible coordinate-ring colimit comparisons. Compare the small model defining strictHenselizationRing with the affine neighbourhood colimit using strictHenselizationAffineInclusion_isEquivalence.

Use etaleResidueTriples_filtered_colimit to obtain filteredness and a universal ring cocone c with a compatible structural map rho. Only these clauses are needed; no locality, residue-field calculation, root lifting or henselianity is used.

Compose the canonical colimit comparison isomorphisms to identify strictHenselizationRing with c.pt. For the chart neighbourhood, the coprojection identities and the R-map clause of the diagram comparison show that Spec(rho followed by the inverse comparison), followed by i, is strictHenselizationStructuralMap. The structural-map characterization supplies the last equality.

The affine chart subcategory is essentially small since the affine neighbourhood category is equivalent to its small representative model and full subcategories inherit essential smallness. Take its opposite small model and compose with E. Transfer filteredness from triples and whisker c along this equivalence. Full faithfulness of Spec turns e into a ring isomorphism to A. Extend the cocone along the composite ring isomorphism. Cancellation of the mono i and faithfulness of Spec, applied to ha, identify the transported map with a. Structural maps of triples form a natural transformation from the constant R diagram; each is etale by HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff, and each composite with a cocone leg is a. Apply RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists to this small filtered etale presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω A : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [CommRing A]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (i : Spec R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hs : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ Set.range i)
    (e : Spec (.of A) ≅ strictHenselizationScheme s)
    (a : R →+* A)
    (ha : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) ≫ i =
      e.hom ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap s) :
    letI : Algebra R A := a.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IndEtale R A
